aethel_region_overview.name: The Aethel Region
aethel_region_overview.inspired_by: The rugged, beautiful landscapes of Alaska.
aethel_region_overview.creation_myth: The Legend of the Great Stillness: In the beginning, there were two beings that existed in the void: Fimbulstorm, the embodiment of perfect, unchanging stasis and cold, and Yggdrys, the embodiment of chaotic, uncontrollable growth and life. Their existence was a paradox, and from their silent clash, reality was born. Aethel is a land where the echoes of this primordial conflict still resonate, a place where the unrelenting cold and the tenacious life that clings to it are in a constant, delicate balance.
core_themes: The struggle between nature and technology.
The enduring legacy of the past.
The journey of self-discovery in a harsh, untamed wilderness.

key_locations.name: Veridian City
key_locations.description: The bustling heart of the Aethel region, a rare pocket of true urban development nestled at the edge of the vast wilderness. It's a city of contrasts, where ancient traditions meet cutting-edge, often reckless, technology. The city is a hub for all of the region's major factions, making it a hotbed of political intrigue, corporate espionage, and cultural exchange.

key_locations.name: The Grand Glacier
key_locations.description: A colossal river of ice that dominates the northern landscape, crisscrossed with deep crevasses and ice caves. It is a place of profound silence, immense power, and ancient secrets, believed to be the resting place of a legendary Pokémon.

key_locations.name: The Bellowing Vents
key_locations.description: A geothermally active volcanic area in the southern mountains, characterized by steaming geysers, bubbling mud pots, and rivers of heated water. It's a dangerous but resource-rich area, fiercely contested by Cryosys and the Prospector's Union.

key_locations.name: The Ancestral Bluffs
key_locations.description: Towering cliffs along the western coast, riddled with ancient burial caves and marked with petroglyphs that tell the forgotten stories of Aethel's first peoples. This area is sacred to the Aurora's Chosen and is a place of deep spiritual power.

key_locations.name: Port Lumina
key_locations.description: A hardy, salt-of-the-earth port town that serves as the gateway to Aethel's treacherous northern seas. Its people are resilient and deeply connected to the ocean, and it's the primary stronghold of the Coastal Clan.

key_locations.name: Birchhaven City
key_locations.description: A town nestled in the boreal forests, home to Forrest's Bug-type Gym.

key_locations.name: Gold-Paw Gulch
key_locations.description: A mining settlement that serves as the base for the Prospector's Union and Slade's Rock-type Gym.

key_locations.name: Silverpeak Institute
key_locations.description: A high-tech research facility in the mountains, location of Dr. Elias Vance's Ice-type Gym.

key_locations.name: Fort Reliance
key_locations.description: A fortified town known for its resilience and Warden Kael's Steel-type Gym.

key_locations.name: Tundra Spire
key_locations.description: A remote and spiritual location in the high tundra, home to Elder Torik's Fighting-type Gym.

key_locations.name: Oldgrowth Haven
key_locations.description: A mystical and ancient part of the forest, protected by Rowan and his Grass-type Gym.

aethel_narrative_arcs.description: The ultimate threat to Aethel is the primordial force of cold and stasis, Fimbulstorm, which slumbers within the Grand Glacier. Chairman Thorne, the CEO of Cryosys, secretly believes humanity is a chaotic plague on the world. His final solution is to awaken the leviathan and usher in a new ice age—a 'perfect' world of cold, unchanging order. All other regional conflicts are secondary to, or manipulated by, this central plot.

key_acts.title: A Region on Edge
plot_points: Players begin their journey and are introduced to the simmering tensions in Aethel.
They witness Cryosys's aggressive operations at the Bellowing Vents, the Eon Remnants' shadowy experiments, and the apathetic resource-gathering of the Prospector's Union.
The immediate, visible threat appears to be the potential awakening of the 'Hibernating Giant,' Terrin.

key_acts.title: Heart of the Geyser Fields
plot_points: The Prospector's Union's reckless digging and Cryosys's large-scale energy extraction at the Bellowing Vents push the legendary Pokémon Terrin to the brink of a full eruption.
The players must navigate this conflict and ultimately find a way to calm the rampaging 'Shifting Earth.'
Upon succeeding, they uncover Cryosys's deception: the entire operation was a cover to siphon immense geothermal energy and channel it north to the Grand Glacier.

key_acts.title: The Leviathan Wakes
plot_points: Armed with the terrible truth, the players must now convince the factions of Aethel of the true danger.
The climax of the campaign is a desperate race to the heart of the Grand Glacier to stop Chairman Thorne and Cryosys from completing the final ritual to awaken Fimbulstorm.
This will be the final confrontation to prevent the world from being plunged into a perfect, silent, and frozen eternity.

side_story_arcs.title: The Apex Protocol
side_story_arcs.description: This arc focuses on the Eon Remnants and their twisted experiments to 'perfect' Pokémon. The players uncover a plot to capture rare Pokémon, including the pre-evolution Sneasby, to subject them to the Apex Catalyst, an artificial evolution trigger. The goal is to create an army of powerful, bio-engineered Pokémon like the Aethelian Weavile, which they see as the pinnacle of predator evolution.

key_acts.title: Whispers of Perfection
plot_points: Players encounter evidence of strange Pokémon modifications and hear rumors of rogue scientists operating in remote labs.
They may rescue a Pokémon that has escaped from an Eon Remnants facility, leading them to investigate further.

key_acts.title: The Hunter and the Hunted
plot_points: Players track the Eon Remnants to one of their hidden research outposts, battling trainers with artificially enhanced Pokémon.
They must race to stop the Remnants from capturing a specific, rare Pokémon that is key to the next stage of the Apex Protocol.

key_acts.title: Confronting the Creators
plot_points: The climax occurs at the main Apex Protocol laboratory, where players must confront the lead scientists.
They face off against the Remnants' ultimate creation—a powerful, newly-evolved Apex Pokémon—to shut down the project for good.

aethel_faction_reputation.system_description: The player's actions will influence their standing with the major factions of the Aethel region. Reputation is tracked on a scale from -10 to +10, unlocking different interactions, quests, and rewards.

factions.name: Cryosys
factions.description: A ruthless mega-corporation focused on a new, highly efficient, but ecologically devastating form of energy extraction. Their secret goal is to use their technology to awaken Fimbulstorm to usher in a new ice age of 'perfect order.'

factions.name: The Eon Remnants
factions.description: A secretive organization of rogue scientists obsessed with unlocking and 'perfecting' Pokémon through artificial evolution and genetic modification, no matter the cost.

factions.name: The Northwind Syndicate
factions.description: A criminal organization focused on espionage, corporate sabotage, and the acquisition of rare Pokémon and technology for profit. They are a third party in the region's conflicts, often selling their services to the highest bidder or manipulating events for their own gain.

factions.name: The Aurora's Chosen
factions.description: A spiritual and traditionalist group dedicated to preserving Aethel's ancient history and the delicate balance between humans, Pokémon, and nature. They are the guardians of the region's sacred sites.

factions.name: The Prospector's Union
factions.description: A rugged and independent collective of miners and explorers who know the Aethel wilderness better than anyone. They are focused on discovering and excavating the region's vast mineral wealth.

factions.name: The Coastal Clan
factions.description: A tight-knit community of sailors, fishers, and marine biologists who protect and live in harmony with Aethel's northern seas. They are fiercely territorial and experts in maritime survival.

factions.name: The Frontier Cartographers
factions.description: A neutral guild of adventurers, scholars, and survivalists dedicated to mapping the uncharted territories of Aethel. They serve as guides and information brokers for those brave enough to explore the wilderness.

factions.name: The Wayward Hearth
factions.description: A benevolent, nomadic faction dedicated to providing aid and healing. They operate mobile medical units and conservationist projects, often clashing with the more aggressive, resource-driven factions.

factions.name: The Permafrost Foundation
factions.description: A radical conservationist group with a purist ideology. They believe the Aethel region's ecosystem is perfect and must be protected from all 'outside corruption.' Their methods are extreme, and they view humans as a blight on the natural world.

canon_clarifications.clarification: The Aethelian variants of starter Pokémon from other regions (e.g., Bulbasaur, Chimchar, Popplio lines) are not offered as official starter choices by Professor Aspen. They are rare creatures that exist in the wild and must be discovered through exploration, making the native Aethel starters (Fawnora, Emberling, Kragshell) unique to the player's initial journey.

The Aethelian Lumineon line represents a living, mystical salmon (Water/Psychic or Water/Fairy). The separate 'Salminy' and 'Solmancer' line represents the ghostly echo (Water/Ghost) of these creatures after they have completed their life's journey.

aethel_visiting_pokedex.description: A comprehensive list of non-native Pokémon that inhabit the Aethel region, categorized by their primary biome. Total unique evolutionary lines: 117. Total unique Pokémon species: 254.

aethelian_resonance_mechanic.description: A rare phenomenon unique to the Aethel region where the profound bond between a Trainer and their Pokémon allows them to harmonize with the region's ambient energy, unlocking a temporary and powerful new form.
unlock_requirements: The Pokémon must have the highest possible Bond/Loyalty rating with its Trainer.
The Trainer and Pokémon must experience a significant, shared narrative event known as a 'Catalyst Moment', which is determined by the Storyteller. This is a one-time unlock per Pokémon.

activation.limitation: A Trainer can only activate Aethelian Resonance once per day.

resonant_form.title: The Resonant Form (Collaborative Design)
resonant_form.description: When the Catalyst Moment is achieved, the Player and Storyteller collaborate to permanently define the Pokémon's Resonant Form.

elements_to_define.details: Design a unique temporary look for the Pokémon, inspired by the Trainer's Class and the Catalyst Moment.
The player chooses two of the Pokémon's core stats. These two stats receive a +2 bonus for the duration of the form.
Design a new, custom Ability for the Pokémon that is active only during the transformation.

unity_move.title: The Unity Move (Collaborative Design)
unity_move.description: The Player and Storyteller also design the Pokémon's unique Unity Move during the Catalyst Moment.
unity_move.usage: Can be used once while in Resonant Form.
unity_move.attack_guideline: If the move is an attack, a Base Power of 120 with a minor secondary effect is a good benchmark.

consequences.details: When the Resonant Form ends, the Pokémon is immediately returned to its Poké Ball. It cannot be sent out again for one full round.
